---
title: "Combine h5 counts"
output: html_document
---

This notebook loads all filtered Cell Ranger cDNA and gRNA matrices into a single Seurat object, adds per-cell sample metadata from `metadata/validation_screen_samples.tsv`, stores `gene_id` plus `gene_symbol` in the RNA feature metadata, and stores guide-level metadata in a gRNA assay when guide capture counts are present.

```{r setup}
required_packages <- c("Seurat", "data.table", "Matrix", "here", "stringr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
	!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
	stop(
		"Install required packages before running this notebook: ",
		paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
	)
}

library(Seurat)
library(data.table)
library(Matrix)
library(here)
library(stringr)

source(here("scripts", "R", "utils.R"))
```

```{r load-seurat-object}
h5_dir <- here("data", "filtered_h5")
sample_metadata_path <- here("metadata", "validation_screen_samples.tsv")
guide_reference_path <- here("data", "GSE303901_wtc11_feature_reference.csv")
table_s3_path <- here("..", "results", "formatted_dc_tap_results", "Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv")
table_s4_path <- here("metadata", "Table_S4_primer_gene_list.tsv")
gtf_path <- here("data", "gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
gene_type_cache_path <- here("results", "qc_experiment_June_2026", "gencode_v32_gene_types.tsv")

combined_cdna <- load_validation_seurat_object(
	h5_dir = h5_dir,
	sample_metadata_path = sample_metadata_path,
	guide_reference_path = guide_reference_path,
	table_s3_path = table_s3_path,
	table_s4_path = table_s4_path,
	gtf_path = gtf_path,
	gene_type_cache_path = gene_type_cache_path
)

combined_cdna
```

```{r summary-and-save}
sample_cell_counts <- sort(table(combined_cdna$sample_id), decreasing = TRUE)
sample_cell_counts

head(combined_cdna[[]][, c("sample_id", "sample", "sample_label_long", "batch")])
head(combined_cdna[["RNA"]][[]])

if ("gRNA" %in% names(combined_cdna@assays)) {
	head(combined_cdna[["gRNA"]][[]])
	Matrix::colSums(GetAssayData(combined_cdna, assay = "gRNA", layer = "counts") > 0)[1:10]
}

output_dir <- here("results", "qc_experiment_June_2026")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(
	combined_cdna,
	file = file.path(output_dir, "combined_cdna_seurat.rds")
)

```

combined_cdna
